title: AI Sentinel Observatory — Critical Incidents Register
purpose: Cumulative, source-linked record of confirmed critical real-world AI incidents; not a global risk score or predictions.
inclusionRule: A documented real-world incident involving serious consequential harm, major disruption, or a consequential failure of AI control. The claimed consequence must be supported by primary evidence and clearly separated from speculation.
exclusions: Controlled simulations without qualifying real-world consequences
Near misses where serious harm was prevented and no comparably serious consequence is documented
Hypothetical risks, forecasts, model capability demonstrations, and unexploited vulnerabilities
Multiple articles about one incident (record one event with multiple sources)
Unverified allegations and automated keyword matches
publicationRule: No entry is created by the automatic feed monitor. An entry requires a source-grounded review; when evidence is insufficient, leave the register unchanged.
